title: Feishu entry authentication and first-screen request performance repair
goal: Ensure unauthenticated users enter Feishu OAuth before protected reads, and make the workbench first-screen data flow bounded, diagnosable, and responsive.
target_user: Digital Exhibition Web users opening the local root path or the deployed /test2 base path.
in_scope: Base-path-aware Feishu entry-session guarding for local and /test2 deployments
Safe base-path routing and OAuth return preservation
Bounded Feishu upstream timeout, retry, deduplication, and diagnostic behavior for workbench reads
First-screen loading and recoverable error behavior for COM-001, COM-002, COM-005, WB-001, and WB-002
out_of_scope: Changing Feishu app credentials, callback configuration, or permissions
Writing, deleting, or altering Feishu records
Production deployment, release, or unrelated page redesign
Changing the legacy DEH-LIVE-101-20260914 repair history
success_metric: Unauthenticated entry performs no protected business reads before OAuth; no first-screen request is allowed to wait for the prior 30-second client fallback; affected failures are bounded and actionable; Web tests, build, and read-only live verification produce evidence.
